title: Words a member types in the app are shown to everyone in the gym, and the owner cannot take them down
what: A member's short bio, the names they give their workouts and the names of exercises they make themselves are sent to the gym's mate profiles, where other members of that gym read them. The app only trims them and cuts their length; the server only checks the length. There is no report button for other members and nothing on the owner's desk to hide or remove one member's words, so an insult, an advert or a phone number for a rival business stays up until that member changes it.
expected: Another member can report a profile, and the owner can hide one member's bio and workout names from the gym.
who: members and owners of a gym with workout sharing on
fix_line: Add a report button on a mate's profile and a hide switch for the owner
